lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tat na cheenahi ba(n)nahi pa(n)d paraalaa ||2||
lines.translation: They do not understand the essence of reality, and they gather their worthless bundles of straw. ||2||
The self-willed manmukhs, in ignorance, take the path of evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam bisaariaa bahu karam driRaae ||
lines.translation: They forget the Lord's Name, and in its place, they establish all sorts of rituals.
They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, in the love of duality. ||3||
Driven crazy, infatuated by Maya, they call themselves Pandits - religious scholars;
stained with corruption, they suffer terrible pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jam kaa gal jevaRaa nit kaal sa(n)taavai ||4||
lines.translation: The noose of the Messenger of Death is around their necks; they are constantly tormented by death. ||4||
The Messenger of Death does not even approach the Gurmukhs.
Through the Word of the Shabad, they burn away their ego and duality.
Attuned to the Name, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾਸੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa daasee bhagataa kee kaar kamaavai ||
lines.translation: Maya is the slave of the Lord's devotees; it works for them.
One who falls at their feet attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
He is forever immaculate; he is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kathaa sunahi se dhanava(n)t disahi jug maahee ||
lines.translation: Those who listen to the Lord's Sermon are seen to be the wealthy people in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kau sabh nivahi anadin pooj karaahee ||
lines.translation: Everyone bows down to them, and adores them, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje gun ravahi saache man maahee ||7||
lines.translation: They intuitively savor the Glories of the True Lord within their minds. ||7||
The Perfect True Guru has revealed the Shabad;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਚਉਥੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun mete chauthai chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: it eradicates the three qualities, and attunes the consciousness to the fourth state.
O Nanak, subduing egotism, one is absorbed into God. ||8||4||
Gauree, Third Mehl:
Brahma studied the Vedas, but these lead only to debates and disputes.
He is filled with darkness; he does not understand himself.
And yet, if he chants the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he finds God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa karau phir kaal na khaai ||
lines.translation: So serve the Guru, and you shall not be consumed by death.
The self-willed manmukhs have been consumed by the love of duality. ||1||Pause||
Becoming Gurmukh, the sinful mortals are purified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੀਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad a(n)tar sahaj reedhe ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find intuitive peace and poise deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: meraa prabh paaiaa gur kai sabad seedhe ||2||
lines.translation: I have found my God, through the Guru's Shabad, and I have been reformed. ||2||
God Himself unites us in Union with the True Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere prabh saache kai man bhaae ||
lines.translation: when we become pleasing to the Mind of my True God.
They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the poise of celestial peace. ||3||
Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt.
The blind, self-willed manmukhs constantly eat poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jam da(n)d sahahi sadaa dukh paae ||4||
lines.translation: They are beaten by the Messenger of Death with his rod, and they suffer in constant pain. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮੂਆ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jamooaa na johai har kee saranaaee ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not catch sight of those who enter the Sanctuary of the Lord.
Subduing egotism, they lovingly center their consciousness on the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa rahai har naam liv laaee ||5||
lines.translation: They keep their consciousness constantly focused on the Lord's Name. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevahi se jan niramal pavitaa ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are pure and immaculate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man siu man milaai sabh jag jeetaa ||
lines.translation: Merging their minds into the Mind, they conquer the entire world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: in bidh kusal terai mere meetaa ||6||
lines.translation: In this way, you too shall find happiness, O my friend. ||6||
Those who serve the True Guru are blessed with fruitful rewards.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in their hearts; selfishness and conceit depart from within them.
The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates for them. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਨ ਸੀਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur te kavan kavan na seedho mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Who - who has not been purified by the True Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny?
The devotees are purified, and honored in His Court.
O Nanak, greatness is in the Lord's Name. ||8||5||
Gauree, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun vakhaanai bharam na jaai ||
lines.translation: Those who speak of the three qualities - their doubts do not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan na tootahi mukat na paai ||
lines.translation: Their bonds are not broken, and they do not obtain liberation.
The True Guru is the Bestower of liberation in this age. ||1||
Those mortals who become Gurmukh give up their doubts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj dhun upajai har liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The celestial music wells up, when they lovingly attune their consciousness to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun kaalai kee sir kaaraa ||
lines.translation: Those who are controlled by the three qualities have death hovering over their heads.
